Q-X1-1.question: Are provider acquisition and provider-row normalization/admission commands (download, bar-validity exclusion, tick normalization, short-interest and corporate-action row handling) retained "source access" components that need numbered stories now, or are they optional shipped provider adapters outside the retained inventory until rights approval, with only a neutral admission contract (what makes a bar, print, quote, event, short-interest or corporate-action row admissible) retained under the layer I/O stories (EF1 #570, EF6 #617)?
options: A: retain each as source-access components with numbered owners and a rights gate
B: exclude the provider commands, retain a neutral admission-profile document under #570/#617 and a separate owner for the unrouted short-interest fact family
Q-X1-1.adjudicator_leaning: B, because the product model keeps provider adapters optional and rights-gated, but the admission rules and the unrouted fact family must not disappear.

Q-X1-2.question: Is the declared-universe membership rule (class-derived union constituent-derived members, unknown symbols dropped) a retained supplied-fact/policy component, as the universe-admission responsibility was retained for C0215? If yes, which numbered owner holds it (#598 consumes a declared universe as input; #518 holds catalogues) or is a new story needed?
options: A: retain under an existing owner
C: exclude; universe is caller-supplied input
Q-X1-2.adjudicator_leaning: C for the core library (universe is an input), with the rule documented as a reference adapter profile; owner to confirm.

Q-X1-3.question: May the independent reference formulas in the math audit be recorded as qualification-evidence assets under the owning release acceptance stories (exit item 6 independent evidence), or must independent evidence be authored fresh and the command excluded as tooling?
options: A: retain as qualification evidence assets under acceptance stories (EQ-152, 157, 163, 169, 175, 181)
B: exclude; author fresh independent evidence
Q-X1-3.adjudicator_leaning: A with an independence review, since it deliberately imports no production calculators; the owner decides whether same-author provenance is acceptable.

Q-X1-4.question: Do strategy-specific notification envelope builders (causal occurrence selection, entry-shape and persistence/context reason classification from rank observations, parity replay and shadow export) belong to the retained policy components under #519/#520, or are they consumer-side notification products excluded with only consumer joins?
options: A: retain classification as policy under #519/#520
B: exclude as notification product; record consumer joins
Q-X1-4.adjudicator_leaning: B for the delivery envelope, but the reason classification should be checked against #519 score profiles for duplicated policy.

Q-X1-5.question: Is the equity candidate and its stamped direction, consumed by the option contract selection worker, a retained supplied equity operand (precedent: C0206 to #506) under #520, or only a consumer join to a candidate producer?
options: A: retain as supplied operand under #520
B: consumer join only; option selection stays other-domain
Q-X1-5.adjudicator_leaning: B unless the owner wants option-side consumers of equity candidates enumerated as operand rows.
